note.value: Utility-trailer demand is low in winter, builds from March, peaks May-August (moves, landscaping, construction). Sun Belt markets show a shallower curve than northern ones. [source: BigRentals: How to Keep Your Utility Trailer Rental Busy Year-Round (rental-marketplace guidance; used as evidence for resale demand by inference)]
